20101010.t: Long ago, there was said to be a [Tower Reaching the Sky].
Human drive to challenge the authority of the gods.
A story passed down as a warning against it.
As if I had become the god in the story.
I came to decide the fate of a tower with a single finger.
Crumble...
M.A.D. Office

Yes!
I won again!
I have never seen someone so bad at the 'Block Tower Building' game.

Fufufu...
To think you'd bet doing the dishes, laundry, and even bathroom cleaning as punishments.
s consideration really knows no bounds!

Aaargh!!!
How does it make sense that I'm the only one who keeps losing?!
That's because, before we met , we'd played countless board games like these!

Exactly!
Our skills are good enough to enter the Humanitas Championship.
I agree.
Dammit, if only I hadn't 'doubled down'...!!

Could they have cheated?!
Or maybe some other foul play...!!??

If that was the case...
I will definitely catch them this time!!
O-One last time...!
This time, with quadruple the punishment!
Accept your defeat gracefully, human.
Ahahaha, double of double!
Aw, I'm starting to get bored...

Alright, this is really the last one, okay?
The worst player, Big Boss, goes first.
And just as I pulled a block from the tower and tried to place it on top...
Crumble...

Bwahaha!
You failed again!
I guess today just isn't your day, fufufu!

This is ridiculous..!
How can it collapse when I didn't even touch it?!
Come on, maybe an earthquake suddenly happened!

—is what you thought I'd say!!
You got quadruple punishment, Big Boss!
...Yes, it was indeed an earthquake.

...?
Theta, I didn't feel anything!
The moment the block tower collapsed, a weak vibration was detected by my sensors.

The epicenter is definitely...
New City Construction Site.
What on earth are they doing at the construction site to make vibrations reach all the way here—
The vibrations are continuously increasing...!
Oh...? It really is.

And at this scale...
It feels like something incredibly big, thick, and powerful...
It does not seem to be a simple earthquake.

The interval is highly consistent...
Almost like footsteps—

Huh?
I'm suddenly getting bombarded with messages on my Quartz!
What do they say?

Hold on...
There's a photo attached to the message.
...This is?!

The land of success, the overflowing city of capital.
The promised utopia of success...
Upon the land of those who worship materialism, a god bearing a price tag has descended.

Fufufu...
May you be crushed and vanish under your own greed to amass wealth.

...Now, let it begin.
My nightmare of the forgotten apocalypse.
Go wild to your heart's content, [Umbra Dei].
